findings.statement: asset records are not shape-uniform: status (8/10), unresolved_reason (8/10). The two resolvable assets carry no status/unresolved_reason while the eight unresolved ones do, so a downstream consumer that reads status on every asset breaks on exactly the two it most needs; the core keys themselves are complete.

findings.remediation: generalise the asset_manifest schema (package/report as pattern instead of const) so 01 outputs are machine-checkable across reports.
